crossRefs.note: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.
They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall…
then Yahweh will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier…
No man will be able to stand before you. Yahweh your God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land…
She said to the men, “I know that Yahweh has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that…
There was a trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people; the garrison, and the raiders, also…
For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots, and the sound of horses, even the noise of…
They struck all the cities around Gerar; for the fear of Yahweh came on them, and they plundered all the cities; for…
But Yahweh your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are…
You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

translations.web: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
translations.bsb: I will send My terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn and run.
translations.kjv: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs
translations.asv: I will send my terror before thee, and will discomfit all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
